description: ZNN-Bench is an open Python benchmark of zeroing neural networks (ZNN) and gradient neural networks for time-varying problems, resolved by sampling period and step size. This record archives release 1.0.0: the source code with its unit tests, the experiment configurations and random seeds, the raw and processed full-scale results of experiments E1-E9 and of the robotics case study, the scripts that regenerate the figures and result tables, and the complete material of the reporting-practice meta-analysis (harvest, screening and access-check scripts with their raw outputs, sample, rubric, coding brief, per-publication codes with evidence quotes, adjudication and harmonization files, analysis script). Code: MIT License. Data: CC BY 4.0. The full texts of the publications read for the meta-analysis are not redistributed (copyright); abstracts were removed from the harvested metadata. See README.md for the layout and MANIFEST.sha256 for checksums.
notes: Code (the znnbench package, tests, experiment, analysis and meta-analysis scripts, tools/memguard.py) is licensed under the MIT License; results, figures and meta-analysis data files are licensed under CC BY 4.0.
